## Finding

The product as specified does **not** already exist. Documented in `docs/prior-art.md`.

Vertical HUD in 2025–2026 is still: Source Clone + Photoshop/Photopea PNG + Image Mask/Blend + place on Aitum. Some people share per-game mask packs (Apex, etc.).

Nearby tools we should **not** reinvent:

- **Source Clone** — we sample internally the same way
- **Advanced Masks** — manual shapes / image masks; no highlighter, no presence
- **Visual Crop** — visual *rectangle* crop only
- **Advanced Scene Switcher video condition** — closest auto-hide; still needs a hand-made cut-out and a template; it is a macro box, not a source

Absence is because this is a product combo + quality of cleanup/presence, not because libobs forbids it.
